title: The Harbor of Manchester's mill district
author: Tamsin Sterling
blurb: Theo Sterling, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, has spent ten years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
